integrity: The proof is by homogeneous polynomial identities and an exact Jacobian factorization; finite sampling is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The description assumes the six roots of \(c_2d_4\) are distinct, equivalently \(C\) and \(D\) are squarefree and coprime.
Only the reduced base locus is classified; the nonreduced base scheme and a minimal resolution of indeterminacy are not claimed.
A classical Cremona classification may contain an equivalent abstract transformation under different coordinates.
title: The rank-12 K3 Nikulin map is a quartic Cremona involution with a five-line base locus
